correctness.rationale: For a nonempty loopless ternary cyclic profile the flow conservation laws force one signed triangle circulation and three nonnegative reciprocal-pair counts. Every such nonzero flow is connected on its active vertices and admits a cyclic Euler tour. For zero circulation, path excursions form necklaces on two types and three-pair support admits explicit 012-separated base witnesses. For positive circulation, a single reciprocal pair corresponds to cyclic weak compositions; two or more reciprocal pairs admit distinct witnesses separated by their 012 counts, preserved under edge expansion. The disjoint families give two rational generating functions; coefficient checks n=1..100 and exhaustive cyclic fibers n=2..16 (131070 indexed words) corroborate, not replace, the proof. No unavailable certificate is needed.

value.rationale: Directed length-two read multiplicities are a natural restricted string-reconstruction channel. Beyond standard flow feasibility, the claim exactly decides uniqueness for every observed profile, enumerates the full space and unique fibers, gives the first ambiguity cases, and proves singleton fibers remain bounded (at most 15) while the exact zero-error profile capacity grows cubically. The nonrepeating ternary constraint is the smallest complete directed transition graph containing both oriented triangles and reciprocal two-cycles, which explains the six-period arithmetic. It is a motivated complete classification, not a one-off small numerical recomputation.
